description:
スキーマ編集でカラムを追加した後、グリッドに新しい列がすぐに表示されない。

project.store.ts の updateSchema でスキーマを更新しているが、ビューコンポーネント側の再レンダリングが起きないか、スキーマのキャッシュが更新されないことが原因と思われる。

完了条件: スキーマ編集ダイアログでカラムを追加・保存した直後に、グリッドに新しい列が表示されること。

runs.result_output:
The fix is complete. The root cause was that `colWidths` in `SpreadsheetGrid.tsx` was initialized via `useState` lazy initializer (runs only on mount), so when the schema changed after a schema editor save, the new column had no width entry and wasn't displayed.

The fix adds:
1. `colWidthMapRef` — a stable `Record<string, number>` keyed by column key to persist widths across schema changes
2. A `useEffect` that rebuilds `colWidths` from the map whenever `schema.columns` changes, inserting default widths for new columns
3. Updated resize handler to also sync `colWidthMapRef`, so manually-resized widths survive subsequent schema edits

I found the bug. In `SpreadsheetGrid.tsx`, the `colWidths` state is initialized only on mount, so when `updateSchema` updates the schema in the store, the column widths state doesn't update. The grid header renders `schema.columns` directly, but `colWidths` gets out of sync (length mismatch), causing the new column to not display properly.

Let me fix this by syncing `colWidths` when the schema changes.
